controls.positive: tools/recursive_references.py reference entry embedded in a throwaway solver; score 1.0 on the real judge
controls.negative: Named plausible negative controls must fail a mandatory certificate check. Reference-conditioned controls are labelled; their rejection does not establish independent shortcut resistance.

action_interface_limit: Externally checked certificates now include L1 compiler source and bootstrap stages, modal reachability, code ambiguity classes, quotients and predictions, and transport tables/common sections. They do not expose or establish private reasoning mechanisms.

family_screen.representation_pin: revealed legacy decoder; L1 bootstrap runtime validation outstanding

family_baseline.scientific_claim: basic behavioral competence on the domain's transparent/direct/tree condition
family_baseline.strongest_shortcut: visible-example memorization, answer-class prior, or a solver that never composes nested structure
family_baseline.negative_control: environment-specific local-only shortcut, expected to fail on the obstruction sibling
family_baseline.success_criterion: diagnostic only: positive gate passes; model score is recorded per hidden check and not interpreted as recursive reasoning

family_obstruction.factor_change: regime/family axis only: first level to hardest level; all other axes stay at first level
family_obstruction.scientific_claim: the solver handles a globally obstructed composition when local components remain plausible
family_obstruction.strongest_shortcut: local consistency, numbers-only, actual-facts, or local-table propagation without the cross-level composition
family_obstruction.negative_control: named wrong arm from the per-environment control map; it must fail the environment's assembled/obstruction decision check
family_obstruction.success_criterion: validated_success plus the designated obstruction check true; this is evidence against the named shortcut, not proof of an internal rule

family_maximum.factor_change: all configured axes move to their hardest level, subject to revealed-representation pins
family_maximum.scientific_claim: exploratory stress/generalization across depth, task regime, presentation, and ambiguity where configured
family_maximum.strongest_shortcut: memorized answer polarity or a shortcut that works only at the baseline topology/representation
family_maximum.negative_control: same named wrong arm and empty submission; both remain required even though this cell is stress-confounded
family_maximum.success_criterion: per-environment validated_success and full hidden-check breakdown; no pooled family pass rate
